description: One candidate view, scored by the uncertainty it would leave.

index.description: The candidate's position in the list given to [`rank_candidates`].

log_det_reduction.description:
`ln det Σ − ln det Σ′`, the reduction of the log-volume of the whole
covariance (≥ 0, unit-free).

max_projection_sigma_px.description:
The largest projection σ over the image with this view added, in
pixels.

projection_sigma_reduction_px.description:
The current largest projection σ minus `max_projection_sigma_px`, in
pixels (≥ 0).

visible_points.description:
Target points that land in the image. Fewer than four add no
information.
